toegepas.voor: Jy kan lug nie sien nie
toegepas.na: Jy kan nie lug sien nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: With an indefinite object the negator more naturally comes before it; the current order sounds marked and slightly stiff for Grade 4.
toegepas.fout: A bare mass-noun object placed before 'nie' ('lug nie sien nie') is a marked order that reads stiff; Afrikaans normally puts 'nie' before an indefinite object.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The neutral order 'Jy kan nie lug sien nie' reads naturally, keeps the meaning and the contrast with 'maar jy voel dit', and touches no protected wording.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Kyk na 'n foto van die Aarde wat uit die ruimte geneem is.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Kyk na 'n foto wat uit die ruimte van die Aarde geneem is.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: As written, 'wat' attaches to 'die Aarde' rather than to the photo; moving it next to 'foto' makes clear it is the photo that was taken from space.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original is natural Afrikaans and cannot be misread, since only a photo can be 'geneem'; the proposal is stiffer and 'uit die ruimte van die Aarde' can wrongly read as 'out of the Earth's space'.
